name: spreadsheet_int_quantity_crash
source: audit F9 shape: Spreadsheet.get() returns a plain int for a unitless cell, the model calls .Value on it and the script dies with "'int' object has no attribute 'Value'"; the next round fixes it. The sheet was created by the failed script, so a leftover 'Params' would turn the retry's sheet into 'Params001'.
prompt: make a plate whose length is count_n times 10 mm, driven by a Params spreadsheet

args.code:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
d = App.getDocument('{doc}')
sheet = d.addObject('Spreadsheet::Sheet', 'Params')
sheet.set('A1', '4')
sheet.setAlias('A1', 'count_n')
d.recompute()
n = sheet.get('count_n').Value
o = d.addObject('Part::Box', 'Plate')
o.Length = 10 * n
d.recompute()

rounds.note: the retry reads the cell through getattr

args.code:
import FreeCAD as App
import Part
d = App.getDocument('{doc}')
sheet = d.addObject('Spreadsheet::Sheet', 'Params')
sheet.set('A1', '4')
sheet.setAlias('A1', 'count_n')
d.recompute()
n = getattr(sheet.get('count_n'), 'Value', sheet.get('count_n'))
o = d.addObject('Part::Box', 'Plate')
o.Length = 10 * n
d.recompute()

events.text: The plate is 40 mm long, driven by count_n.
